goal: Preserve familiar monthly bars while adding optional trends, clear recovery and date-adjacent totals through existing ledger interactions.
non_goals: No automated real-ledger write tests; owner-requested connected-page manual review is allowed
No push or deployment; owner now explicitly approved human review and the local implementation/test/record commit, recorded in development/human-review.json
expected_evidence: Actual-source failing then passing regression tests
Independent review evidence and honest acceptance status
unsafe_assumptions: The prototype's synthetic year cutoff is not a production data policy
Recovery's reporting range is not necessarily the displayed year
DOM bar endpoints can change after responsive reflow
Browser click or artifact-save success alone does not prove UI effect
stop_condition: Stop before production edits unless entry and baseline pass; stop on scope violations, unauthorized real-data operations, new product decisions, failed tests or review findings.
